allocation_by_worker.name: allocation_by_worker
allocation_by_worker.where: person_id IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL

allocation_open_demand.name: allocation_open_demand
allocation_open_demand.where: person_id IS NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL

allocation_one_placeholder_per_request.name: allocation_one_placeholder_per_request
allocation_one_placeholder_per_request.where: resource_request_id IS NOT NULL AND person_id IS NULL

allocation_worker_rule_check.name: allocation_worker_rule_check
allocation_worker_rule_check.value: (status = 'placeholder' AND person_id IS NULL) OR (status IN ('tentative','committed') AND person_id IS NOT NULL)

allocation_committed_dates_check.name: allocation_committed_dates_check
allocation_committed_dates_check.value: status = 'placeholder' OR date_from IS NOT NULL

kpi_norm_metric_component_2_label_check.name: kpi_norm_metric_component_2_label_check
kpi_norm_metric_component_2_label_check.value: component_count = 1 OR component_2_label IS NOT NULL
